an HPRG-related protein is present in human skeletal muscle and that the protein associates with AMP deaminase.
an HPRG-related protein is associated to the AMP deaminase of human skeletal muscle.

a protein that is present in human skeletal muscle and is related in some manner to the AMPD enzyme.
the presence in skeletal muscle of an HPRGP-like protein, which may have a role in regulating muscle AMPD activity.
the characterization of a protein that is associated with human skeletal muscle AMP de-aminase and that reacts with an antibody against human HPRG.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the protein detected in the muscle AMPD preparations by means of immunoblotting with the anti-HPRGs is an isoform of the plasma glycoprotein.
an HPRG-associated protein, possibly identical to human plasma HPRGP, is present in human skeletal muscle and is associated with the Type IIB fiber-specific isoform of AMPD.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the HPRG-like AMPD-associated protein is a novel protein that may be involved in the regulation of AMPD in skeletal muscle.

an HPRG-related protein, which is associated with the Type IIB muscle fiber AMPD, may play a role in the regulation of muscle energy metabolism.

the presence of HPRG-like proteins in skeletal muscle is not an artifact due to cross-reacting antibodies.
